rules.description: Design and implementation SHOULD honor the decision recorded in ADR-0026 (nodejs track). ADR decision: Rollout an Adaptive Risk Managed MFA Framework driving the Core authentication pipeline: 1. Passwordless First : Infuse native WebAuthn (Passkeys) into authentication flows, empowering end users to bind high security hardware (TouchID, FaceID, Yubikeys) natively to logins. Manual attestation required — not machine-verifiable.
